title: •Hem Dazon
caption: •Hem Dazon (V)
lore: Male scout from Cona. As with many Arconas, Hem has succumbed to the power of salt, an addiction indicated by his gold eye color.
game_text: During your deploy phase, may stack ‘salt’ (a card from hand) face down under Hem. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each ‘salt’ card. During your control phase (or if Hem lost), may place all ‘salt’ cards in your Used Pile.
